title: Fed Chair Warsh Warns Stubborn Inflation Could Push Toward Rate Hike at Jackson Hole Debut
summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivered his first Jackson Hole keynote Friday, warning that persistent inflation may push the Fed toward a rate hike. He rejected forward guidance and stressed that 'elevated prices should be the central bank's main focus,' putting him at odds with White House calls for rate cuts.
why: 全球市场核心事件：美联储主席沃什首次杰克逊霍尔发言释放鹰派信号，明确上调利率可能性，打压降息预期；对整体风险资产（港股/A股）构成压力，同时对黄金价格有双重影响（抗通胀支撑 vs 加息预期压制）；期权卖方需重点关注隐含波动率。

title: Nvidia Adds $442 Billion in Second-Biggest-Ever One-Day Stock Surge After Blowout Q2 Results
summary: Nvidia reported Q2 FY2027 revenue of $96.2 billion (+106% YoY) and guided to $106–110 billion next quarter, projecting 70% revenue growth for fiscal 2028. NVDA shares surged 8.74%, adding $442B to its market cap — the second-largest single-day gain in stock market history. The Nasdaq rose 1.6% and S&P 500 gained 0.7% on the AI optimism wave.
why: 英伟达业绩爆发是本周最重要的美股事件，提振全球AI概念股，英特尔单日涨逾4%；同时确认AI基建需求旺盛，对持仓中SK海力士（HBM供应）、美光、英特尔等间接利好；Nasdaq大涨改善市场情绪，利于sell put策略持仓估值。

title: Gold Holds Above $4,600 as Global Markets Position Ahead of Warsh's Jackson Hole Keynote
summary: Physical gold traded above $4,600/oz on Friday — near a three-month high — as markets braced for Fed Chair Warsh's inaugural Jackson Hole speech. Bond yields rose and the U.S. dollar drifted lower into the Fed policy moment. The 2026 Jackson Hole symposium theme is 'Financial Innovation: Implications for Payments and Policy,' running August 27–29.
why: 黄金维持在$4600以上高位直接利好老铺黄金（6181.HK）的产品需求和品牌溢价；同时杰克逊霍尔会议带来的宏观不确定性是隐含波动率上升的潜在驱动力，对持有sell put组合需格外关注。

title: China Industrial Profits Rose 17.6% in Jan–Jul 2026; July Alone Slows to +11.2%, a 7-Month Low
summary: China's NBS data released August 27 showed industrial profits up 17.6% YoY for the first seven months of 2026 (total: RMB 4.58 trillion), but July standalone growth decelerated to 11.2% — the weakest monthly pace in seven months. Computer, communications and electronic equipment manufacturing surged 110%; high-tech manufacturing profits rose 50.1%.
why: NBS官方数据显示中国工业利润增速放缓，7月单月创7个月新低，反映消费需求疲弱信号；科技制造业利润+110%对腾讯、阿里云、小米等科技持仓基本面中性偏正；数据支持政府后续维持宽松政策的预期，利于A股整体情绪。

title: Tencent Repurchases 909,000 Shares for HKD 550 Million on August 27
summary: Tencent Holdings (0700.HK) conducted one of its largest single-day buybacks of the program on August 27, repurchasing 909,000 ordinary shares totaling approximately HKD 550 million. Total shares repurchased under the current mandate have reached approximately 44.8 million, or about 0.49% of the authorized 10% maximum.
why: 腾讯单日回购规模环比显著提升（较此前约3亿港元/日跳升至约5.5亿港元），管理层持续强力护盘，体现对股价低估的判断；对持有腾讯多头及卖put策略均属正面信号，回购提供下方支撑。数字未经港交所公告直接核实，标注 verified:false。
